changelog.title: Welcome to SteamLite 6.0.0!
items: SUE Editor Enabled: Create custom layouts, add widgets, and morph the UI however you want.
Custom Themes: Import and export your UI themes as JSON files.
Floating Add Non-Steam Game button in the library.
GitHub-powered News & Announcements section on the Home page.
Various bug fixes and performance improvements.

news.title: Theme Marketplace Coming Soon
news.content: We are working on a built-in theme downloader so you can browse and install custom UI themes directly from the app without leaving SteamLite!

news.title: UI Editor (SUE) Now Available
news.content: The SteamLite UI Editor is now available in the Advanced Settings. Turn on Edit Mode to drag, drop, and morph buttons and panels. Build your dream Steam client layout!
